## Summary

Synthetica Labs is building next-generation machine learning infrastructure for autonomous
decision-making systems. We are a synthetic JD fixture used to test the resume pipeline
against the lever portal shape. Do not treat as a real role.

We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to help design and own our production
ML stack. You will work closely with research, product, and platform teams to bring models
from experimentation to reliable production systems that serve millions of requests per day.

## Responsibilities

- Design and deploy ML pipelines at production scale using Python-based orchestration frameworks
- Own model lifecycle from initial research through deployment, monitoring, and incident response
- Mentor junior ML engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and pair programming
- Partner with product and data teams to translate ambiguous requirements into well-scoped systems
- Drive evaluation rigor and reproducibility across the model development lifecycle
- Contribute to internal tooling for experiment tracking, dataset management, and feature stores
- Lead architecture reviews of model serving infrastructure and distributed training setups
- Drive A/B testing and statistical evaluation to measure model impact on business outcomes

## Required Skills

- 5+ years of Python in production ML environments with real user-facing impact
- Deep familiarity with PyTorch or JAX including custom training loops and mixed precision
- Experience deploying and scaling ML workloads on Kubernetes clusters
- Strong SQL and data modeling skills across OLAP and OLTP data stores
- Comfortable owning systems in production including on-call rotations and incident retrospectives
- BS/MS in Computer Science, Statistics, or equivalent industry experience with similar depth
- Experience with distributed training frameworks (FSDP, DeepSpeed) and inference optimization
- Solid software engineering fundamentals including testing strategies, CI/CD, and code review
- Strong written and verbal communication skills for cross-functional alignment
- Experience leading technical projects end-to-end from scoping through delivery and retrospective

## Preferred

- Open-source contributions to ML frameworks or tooling with public code to share
- LLM experience including RAG architectures, fine-tuning workflows, and evaluation harnesses
- Familiarity with MLOps tooling such as Weights & Biases, MLflow, or similar platforms
- Track record of growing and mentoring other engineers in a team environment
- Background in research with publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or equivalent venues

## Compensation

$180,000 – $240,000 base salary + equity + comprehensive benefits package

Benefits include full medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, unlimited PTO, home
office stipend, and annual learning and development budget. We are a distributed-first team
and all roles are fully remote within the United States.

## About Synthetica Labs

Synthetica Labs was founded to solve the hardest inference and reasoning challenges in
enterprise AI. Our team comes from leading ML research labs and hyperscaler infrastructure
teams. We are Series B with strong ARR growth and a clear path toward profitability.

We believe the best ML engineers are curious, rigorous, and deeply product-minded. If you
care about building reliable systems that create real value and are excited to work at the
intersection of research and engineering, we would love to meet you.

Synthetica Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of
race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status,
or veteran status. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team.

## Interview Process

1. Async technical screen — a take-home systems design question (2 hours, no live coding)
2. Technical interview — 60-minute deep dive into a past ML project you owned end-to-end
3. Systems design — 60-minute collaborative session on ML architecture and trade-off reasoning
4. Cross-functional fit — 45-minute conversation with a product or research partner
5. Offer and reference check — we move fast, typically within one week of the final round

We do not use algorithmic puzzle interviews. We believe in evaluating engineers on the kind
of work they will actually do. All interviews are conducted via video call and can be
scheduled across US time zones with reasonable flexibility.
